claim: Native Rust 1.95.0 compiler mmap denial, internal retry and equal reference metadata under controlled address-space limits on both macOS architectures.
root_cause: Earlier controller limit 35204366336 bytes was lower than 35204493312 bytes at the mmap boundary. Native task_info sampling confirmed growth before setrlimit, whose EINVAL preserved the original limit. Sampling at the mapping boundary before setting current size plus 4096 bytes repairs the diagnostic.

steps.name: Run printf 'value=%s\n' "$(jq --arg target "$PROBE_TARGET" -c '{include: [.[] | select(($target == "all") or (.target == $target) or (($target == "remaining") and (.target != "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl")))]}' .github/release-matrix.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
Post Debug the original failed workspace
Post Create owned partial build state
